digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, prerequisite finder/verifier, batch runner, decision orchestrator
propositions: Focused prerequisite consistency findings are routed through dedicated finder and verifier passes with canonical prerequisite ID blocks and isolated prompts, preventing prerequisite material from entering general criterion requests.

Prerequisite coverage results are independently reshaped and decided alongside general findings without shifting index domains, then concatenated before a single shared Pass-3 execution-review evaluation.
Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict at the top level; concurrent DET blockers remain visibly retained in the blocking array and do not flip to BLOCK.

Singleton prerequisite finder evaluation must achieve ≥0.90 recall, ≤0.10 false acceptance, 1.00 coverage completeness, and 0.00 attribution error as a fail-fast proof gate before packed routing and production wiring are implemented.

Packed prerequisite finder calls maintain non-regression against pinned singleton metrics while preserving at least singleton performance; context-limit split recovery never splits subject or prerequisite plan text, only whole blocks or oversized findings tuples.

Prerequisite-scoped findings use a canonical four-field length-prefixed structured identity encoding (version, text, criteria, ID) with SHA-256 hash, while non-prerequisite findings preserve the existing pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.
